text_blocks.snippet: As of July 22, 2025, Singapore is experiencing an increase in COVID-19 cases. The current number of active cases is approximately 1,000.

list.snippet: Variants: The Omicron variant is the primary strain circulating in Singapore.
Transmission: The virus is primarily spread through close contact with infected individuals or through respiratory droplets produced when coughing or sneezing.
Precautions: The Singapore Ministry of Health (MOH) recommends the following precautions:
Wear a mask in public indoor settings
Avoid close contact with sick individuals
If you develop symptoms of COVID-19, seek medical attention immediately.
Testing is available at public health centers and private clinics.
Treatment options include antiviral medications and supportive care.
